en.t: Louis the Stammerer is crowned as king of West Francia by Pope John VIII
en.s: Louis II the Stammerer (French: Louis le Bègue; 1 November 846 – 10 April 879) was the king of Aquitaine and later the king of West Francia. He was the eldest son of Emperor Charles the Bald and Ermentrude of Orléans. Louis II the Stammerer was physically weak and outlived his father by a year and a half.

zh.t: 口吃者路易加冕为西法兰克国王
zh.s: 口吃者路易二世（法语：Louis le Bègue；846年11月1日—879年4月10日）曾任阿基坦国王，后成为西法兰克国王。他是秃头查理皇帝与奥尔良的埃门特鲁德的长子。路易二世体弱多病，比父亲晚一年半去世。

en.s: The first Battle of Ramla (or Ramleh) took place on 7 September 1101 between the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem and the Fatimids of Egypt. The town of Ramla lay on the road from Jerusalem to Ascalon, the latter of which was the largest Fatimid fortress in Palestine. From Ascalon the Fatimid vizier, Al-Afdal Shahanshah, launched almost annual attacks into the newly founded Crusader kingdom from 1099 to 1107. It was thrice the case that the two armies met each other at Ramla. At the first battle the Egyptians were led by Saad el-Dawleh, while the Crusaders were under the command of King Baldwin I, who had only 260 cavalry and 900 foot soldiers.

zh.s: 第一次拉姆拉战役（也称拉姆莱战役）于1101年9月7日爆发，交战双方是耶路撒冷十字军王国和埃及法蒂玛王朝。拉姆拉位于耶路撒冷通往阿斯卡隆的道路上，阿斯卡隆是法蒂玛王朝在巴勒斯坦最大的堡垒。1099年至1107年间，法蒂玛王朝宰相阿夫达勒·沙汉沙每年几乎都会从阿斯卡隆出兵，进攻新建立的十字军王国；双方军队曾三次在拉姆拉交战。第一次战役中，埃及军由萨阿德·达乌拉率领，十字军则由鲍德温一世国王指挥；他手下只有260名骑兵和900名步兵。

en.t: Cardinal Rolando Bandinelli is elected Pope Alexander III, prompting the election of Cardinal Octaviano Monticelli as Antipope Victor IV the same day
en.s: Pope Alexander III (c. 1100/1105 – 30 August 1181), born Roland (Italian: Rolando), was head of the Catholic Church and ruler of the Papal States from 7 September 1159 until his death in 1181. A native of Siena, Alexander became pope after a contested election, but had to spend much of his pontificate outside Rome while several rivals, supported by Holy Roman Emperor Frederick I Barbarossa, claimed the papacy.

zh.t: 红衣主教罗兰多·班迪内利当选教宗亚历山大三世；同日，红衣主教奥塔维亚诺·蒙蒂切利当选对立教宗维克多四世
zh.s: 教宗亚历山大三世（约1100/1105年—1181年8月30日），本名罗兰（意大利语：Rolando），自1159年9月7日起担任天主教会领袖和教宗国统治者，直至1181年去世。他出生于锡耶纳，在一次有争议的选举后成为教宗；但在其任期的大部分时间里，他不得不留在罗马以外，因为神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈一世“巴巴罗萨”支持的数名对手也声称拥有教宗职位。

en.s: The Battle of Ichihara (市原合戦, Ichihara Kassen) was a battle which took place in Shinano Province on September 7, 1180 (Jishō calendar) (September 29, 1180 in the Julian calendar). It took place during the Genpei War, a civil war over control of Japan from 1180 to 1185. This is the first battle in which Minamoto no Yoshinaka appears in historical documents.

zh.s: 市原合战（市原合戦，Ichihara Kassen）于1180年9月7日（治承历；儒略历为1180年9月29日）在信浓国发生，是1180年至1185年间源平合战的一部分。这是源义仲首次出现在史料记载中的战役。

en.s: The Battle of Arsuf took place on 7 September 1191, as part of the Third Crusade. It saw a multi-national force of Crusaders, led by Richard I of England, defeat a significantly larger army of the Ayyubid Sultanate, led by Saladin. Following the Crusaders' capture of Acre, Saladin moved to intercept Richard's advancing army just outside of the city of Arsuf (Arsur in Latin) as it moved along the coast from Acre towards Jaffa.

zh.s: 阿苏夫战役是第三次十字军东征的一部分，于1191年9月7日爆发。英格兰国王理查一世率领多国十字军，击败了萨拉丁率领的规模大得多的阿尤布苏丹国军队。十字军攻占阿卡后，萨拉丁在阿苏夫城外拦截理查的军队；理查的部队正沿海岸从阿卡向雅法推进。阿苏夫的拉丁语名为Arsur。

en.t: Holy Roman Emperor Frederick II lands in Acre, and starts the Sixth Crusade, which results in a peaceful restoration of the Kingdom of Jerusalem
en.s: The Sixth Crusade (1228–1229), also known as the Crusade of Frederick II, was a military expedition to recapture Jerusalem and the rest of the Holy Land. It began seven years after the failure of the Fifth Crusade and involved very little actual fighting. The diplomatic maneuvering of the Holy Roman emperor and king of Sicily, Frederick II, resulted in the Kingdom of Jerusalem regaining some control over Jerusalem for much of the ensuing fifteen years as well as over other areas of the Holy Land.

zh.t: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈二世抵达阿克，发动第六次十字军东征；这次东征以和平方式恢复耶路撒冷王国
zh.s: 第六次十字军东征（1228—1229）也称腓特烈二世十字军，是一场旨在夺回耶路撒冷和圣地其他地区的军事远征。它在第五次十字军东征失败七年后开始，几乎没有发生实际战斗。神圣罗马帝国皇帝兼西西里国王腓特烈二世通过外交斡旋，使耶路撒冷王国重新控制了耶路撒冷及圣地其他地区，并在随后约15年间大体维持这一局面。

en.s: The siege of Poitiers was a siege of the French city of Poitiers in summer 1569 as part of the French Wars of Religion. By that time, the city was a Catholic stronghold faithful to Charles IX of France, though Jean Calvin had preached there in 1534 and it had taken the Protestant side from May to July 1563 before being recaptured by the Catholic Royalist party.

en.t: Thomas Howard, 4th Duke of Norfolk, is arrested for his role in the Ridolfi plot to assassinate Queen Elizabeth I of England and replace her with Mary, Queen of Scots
en.s: Thomas Howard, 4th Duke of Norfolk, (10 March 1536 or 1538 – 2 June 1572), was an English nobleman and politician. He was a second cousin of Queen Elizabeth I and held many high offices during the earlier part of her reign.

zh.t: 诺福克公爵托马斯·霍华德因参与里多尔菲阴谋被捕
zh.s: 诺福克公爵托马斯·霍华德（1536年或1538年3月10日—1572年6月2日）是英格兰贵族和政治人物，与英国女王伊丽莎白一世是表亲。在伊丽莎白统治前期，他曾担任多个高级职务。

en.s: The Treaty of Southampton was an alliance between England and the Dutch Republic against the Kingdom of Spain. Concluded at Southampton on September 7, 1625, the pact was drawn in French, and agreed to establish the King of Spain as a common enemy of the two nations: "afin d'assaillir le Roy d'Espaigne a guerre ouverte, en tous ses royaumes, terres, subjects, et droicts, en tous lieux, deçá et delá la ligne, par mer et par terre." ('for the purpose of attacking the King of Spain in open war in all his realms in all places, on this side and beyond the line, by land and sea').

zh.s: 《南安普敦条约》是英格兰与荷兰共和国结成的反西班牙联盟。条约于1625年9月7日在南安普敦签订，以法文起草，双方同意将西班牙国王列为共同敌人：“在所有地方发动公开战争，攻击西班牙国王的全部王国、领地、臣民和权利，无论界线这边还是那边，陆上或海上皆然。”

en.s: The Battle of St. Kitts or St. Cristopher was a successful Spanish expedition that seized the islands of Saint Kitts and Nevis from the English and French during the Anglo-Spanish War (1625–30).

en.s: The battle of Babylon Hill was an indecisive skirmish that took place between Royalist and Parliamentarian forces near Yeovil, in South West England, on 7 September 1642, during the early stages of the First English Civil War. The engagement occurred after a failed Parliamentarian siege of nearby Royalist-held Sherborne. After the Parliamentarians had retreated to Yeovil, a force of around 350 Royalists was sent to reconnoitre their movements.

zh.s: 第一次英国内战初期，保王党与议会派军队于1642年9月7日在英格兰西南部约维尔附近的巴比伦山发生小规模交战，战斗没有明确结果。此前，议会派围攻附近由保王党控制的舍伯恩城，但未能成功。议会派撤回约维尔后，约350名保王党士兵被派去侦察他们的动向。

en.s: The siege of Portsmouth was the siege of a Royalist garrison in Portsmouth by a Parliamentarian force conducted in the early part of the First English Civil War. The siege resulted in Portsmouth falling to Parliament after a little under a month of conflict.

en.s: The Guo Huaiyi rebellion (also romanized as Kuo Huai-i rebellion) was a peasant revolt by Chinese farmers against Dutch rule in Taiwan in 1652. Sparked by dissatisfaction with heavy Dutch taxation on them but not the aborigines and extortion by low-ranking Dutch officials and servicemen, the rebellion initially gained ground before being crushed by a coalition of Dutch soldiers and their aboriginal allies.

zh.s: 郭怀一起义于1652年在台湾爆发，是当地农民反抗荷兰统治的一场起义。农民不满荷兰人向他们征收重税、却不向原住民征同样的税，也不满低级别荷兰官员和军人的敲诈勒索，因此发动起义。起义初期一度扩大，后来被荷兰士兵与原住民盟友组成的联军镇压。

en.t: Capture of the Grand Mughal Fleet
en.s: The capture of the Great Mughal Fleet was an armed naval encounter in the history of piracy that targeted the Mughal Empire. On 7 September 1695, the English pirate Henry Every captured 2 ships out of the 25-ship convoy of Imperial Mughal vessels making the annual pilgrimage to Mecca, namely the treasure-laden Mogul ship known as the Ganj-i-Sawai and its escort, Fateh Muhammed.

zh.s: 莫卧儿大船队被俘是海盗袭击莫卧儿帝国历史上的一次海上武装冲突。1695年9月7日，英格兰海盗亨利·埃弗里从一支前往麦加朝圣、由25艘莫卧儿帝国船只组成的船队中俘获两艘：满载财宝、名为“甘吉萨瓦伊”的大型船只及其护航船“法塔赫·穆罕默德”号。

en.s: The Siege of Turin, June to September 1706, took place during the War of the Spanish Succession. A French army led by Louis de la Feuillade besieged the Savoyard capital of Turin, whose relief by Prince Eugene of Savoy has been called the most brilliant campaign of the war in Italy. The siege is also famous for the death of Piedmontese hero Pietro Micca.
en.n: War of the Spanish Succession: Siege of Turin ends, leading to the withdrawal of French forces from North Italy.

zh.s: 都灵围城战于1706年6月至9月在西班牙王位继承战争期间进行。路易·德·拉·费亚德率领法军围攻萨伏依首都都灵。萨伏依的欧根亲王率军解围，这场战役被称为该战争在意大利最出色的军事行动。皮埃蒙特英雄彼得罗·米卡也在围城战中阵亡，因此这场战事广为人知。
zh.n: 西班牙王位继承战争：都灵围城战结束，法军随后撤出意大利北部。

en.s: The War of the Spanish Succession was a conflict between the European great powers, fought between 1701 and 1714. The death of the childless Charles II of Spain in November 1700 led to a succession crisis, the rival claimants being Philip of Anjou, grandson of Louis XIV of France, and Archduke Charles of Austria, supported by the Grand Alliance.

zh.s: 西班牙王位继承战争是欧洲列强之间的一场冲突，发生于1701年至1714年。1700年11月，无嗣的西班牙国王卡洛斯二世去世，引发王位继承危机。主要竞争者是法国国王路易十四的孙子安茹公爵腓力，以及得到大同盟支持的奥地利大公查理。

en.s: The Battle of Moys was a battle fought on September 7, 1757 during the Seven Years' War. A Prussian army of 13,000 men fought an Austrian army of double their size. The entire Prussian corps surrendered to the Austrians.The battle was fought near Görlitz, in Upper Lusatia, present-day Zgorzelec in Poland.

zh.s: 七年战争期间，莫伊斯战役于1757年9月7日爆发。1.3万名普鲁士士兵与人数约为其两倍的奥地利军队交战。普鲁士军团全体向奥地利军队投降。战斗发生在上卢萨蒂亚的格尔利茨附近，即今波兰兹戈热莱茨一带。

en.s: The French invaded the island of Dominica in the British West Indies on 7 September 1778 during the American Revolutionary War. The action took place before British authorities in the Caribbean were aware that France had entered the war as an ally of the United States of America. The French governor in the West Indies, François Claude Amour, marquis de Bouillé, was notified on 17 August that France was at war, and organized the invasion, infiltrating spies to rally sympathetic French-speaking Dominican support. Early on 7 September 1778, French forces landed on the southeastern coast of the island.

zh.s: 美国独立战争期间，法军于1778年9月7日入侵英属西印度群岛中的多米尼克岛。加勒比地区的英国当局当时还不知道法国已作为美国的盟友参战。8月17日，法国西印度群岛总督弗朗索瓦·克洛德·阿穆尔·德·布耶侯爵接到法国参战的通知，随后组织入侵，并派间谍联络岛上讲法语、支持法国的居民。9月7日清晨，法军在岛屿东南岸登陆。

en.s: The Capture of Fort Bute signalled the opening of Spanish intervention in the American Revolutionary War on the side of France and the United States. Mustering an ad hoc army of Spanish regulars, Acadian militia, and native levies under Gilbert Antoine de St. Maxent, Bernardo de Gálvez, the Governor of Spanish Louisiana stormed and captured the small British frontier post on Bayou Manchac on September 7, 1779.

zh.s: 布特堡被攻占，标志着西班牙站在法国和美国一方介入美国独立战争。西班牙人临时集结了一支军队，由西班牙正规军、阿卡迪亚民兵和原住民征募兵组成，吉尔伯特·安托万·德·圣马克桑负责指挥。1779年9月7日，西属路易斯安那总督贝尔纳多·德加尔维斯率军突袭并攻占了曼查克河口的一座小型英国边境哨所。

en.s: The Battle of Copenhagen (also known as the Bombardment of Copenhagen) occurred between 16 August and 7 September 1807 during the Napoleonic Wars. British forces bombarded the Danish capital of Copenhagen in order to capture or destroy the Royal Dano-Norwegian Navy. Following the Danish surrender, most of their navy was seized by the British and taken to England.

zh.s: 拿破仑战争期间，哥本哈根战役（又称哥本哈根轰炸）于1807年8月16日至9月7日进行。英军轰炸丹麦首都哥本哈根，意图夺取或摧毁丹麦-挪威皇家海军。丹麦投降后，英军扣押了丹麦海军的大部分舰艇，并将其运往英格兰。

en.s: The Battle of Borodino or the Battle of the Moskva took place on the outskirts of Moscow near the village of Borodino on 7 September 1812, during Napoleon's invasion of Russia. The Grande Armée fought against the Imperial Russian Army. After the Russian retreat at the Battle of Smolensk, the road to Moscow lay open.

zh.s: 博罗季诺战役也称莫斯科河战役，于1812年9月7日在莫斯科郊外、博罗季诺村附近爆发，是拿破仑入侵俄国期间的一场战斗。法兰西大军与俄国帝国军队交战。斯摩棱斯克战役后俄军撤退，通往莫斯科的道路因此敞开。

en.s: The Battle of Lippa was an engagement which took place on 7 September 1813 in what is now Croatia. The Austrians defeated the Franco-Italians. Though a small engagement, the battle formed part of the Adriatic campaign of 1807–1814, which would lead to the fall of the Illyrian Provinces.

zh.s: 利帕战役于1813年9月7日在今克罗地亚境内爆发。奥地利军队击败了法意联军。尽管规模不大，这场战斗仍是1807至1814年亚得里亚海战役的一部分；该战役最终导致伊利里亚省覆灭。

en.s: The independence of Brazil (Portuguese: independência do Brasil) began after a series of political and military events that led the Kingdom of Brazil to separate from the United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves. It is celebrated on 7 September, the date in 1822 when prince regent Pedro of Braganza, beside the Ipiranga brook, declared independence from Portugal – a declaration that became known as the Cry of Ipiranga.

zh.s: 巴西独立（葡萄牙语：independência do Brasil）经历了一系列政治和军事事件，最终使巴西王国脱离葡萄牙、巴西和阿尔加维联合王国。巴西独立日定于9月7日，纪念1822年摄政王佩德罗·德·布拉干萨在伊皮兰加溪畔宣布脱离葡萄牙独立；这一宣言后来被称为“伊皮兰加呐喊”。

en.t: 1824 United States House of Representatives elections in Vermont
en.s: Vermont elected its members September 7, 1824. Congressional districts were re-established in Vermont for the 1824 election. Vermont had used an at-large district 1812-1818 and 1822. A majority was required for election, which was not met in the 1st district, necessitating a second election December 6, 1824.

zh.t: 1824年美国众议院选举：佛蒙特州
zh.s: 佛蒙特州于1824年9月7日选出联邦众议员。该州为1824年选举重新设立了国会选区；此前在1812年至1818年及1822年选举中，全州曾合并为一个选区。候选人须获得多数票方可当选，但第一选区无人达到这一要求，因此于1824年12月6日举行第二轮选举。

en.s: The Capture of Veloz Passagera was a single-ship action that occurred during the British Royal Navy's anti-slavery blockade of Africa in the early and mid 19th century. The sloop-of-war HMS Primrose, of 18 guns, under Captain William Broughton, captured the 20-gun Spanish slave ship Veloz Passagera, Jozé Antonio de la Vega, master.

en.s: The 1852 Vermont gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday, September 7. Incumbent governor Charles K. Williams, a Whig, was not a candidate for reelection. The canal was built from 1845 to 1856 and opened on 7 September [O.S. 26 August] 1856. It was overhauled and widened in 1963–1968.

en.s: The Mountain Meadows Massacre (September 7–11, 1857) was a series of attacks during the Utah War that resulted in the mass murder of at least 120 members of the Baker–Fancher wagon train. The massacre occurred in the southern Utah Territory at Mountain Meadows, and was perpetrated by settlers from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (LDS Church) involved with the Utah Territorial Militia (officially called the Nauvoo Legion).

en.s: The 1858 Vermont gubernatorial election for governor of Vermont was held on Tuesday, September 7. In keeping with the "Mountain Rule", incumbent Republican Ryland Fletcher was not a candidate for a third one-year term. The Republican nominee was Hiland Hall. The Democratic nominee was Henry Keyes, who was also the Democratic nominee in 1856 and 1857. Vermont continued to strongly support abolitionism and the Republican Party, and Hall was easily elected.

Initially divided by pro-slavery Chivalrists and anti-slavery Free Soilers, by 1857, the party had split into the Lecompton and Anti-Lecompton factions.

en.s: The Battle of Riggins Hill (September 7, 1862) was a minor engagement in western Tennessee during the American Civil War. A Confederate raiding force under Colonel Thomas Woodward captured Clarksville, Tennessee, threatening Union shipping on the Cumberland River. Several Union regiments led by Colonel William Warren Lowe advanced from nearby Fort Donelson and drove off the Confederates after a struggle lasting less than an hour.

en.s: The Skirmish at Ashley's Mill, sometimes called the Skirmish at Ferry Landing was an engagement that was fought between Union Army and Confederate States Army cavalry regiments in Arkansas on September 7, 1863 during the American Civil War. Union Brigadier General John Davidson commanding the cavalry division of the Union Army of Arkansas sent the 7th Missouri Volunteer Cavalry Regiment as his lead regiment to clear the 5th Arkansas Cavalry Regiment, under the temporary command of Major John Bull while Colonel Robert C. Newton was in temporary brigade command, from its position guarding a crossing of the Arkansas River near Little Rock, Arkansas.

zh.s: 阿什利磨坊小规模战斗有时也称渡口登陆点小规模战斗，是美国内战期间的一场交战，于1863年9月7日在阿肯色州爆发。交战双方是联邦军和美利坚联盟国军的骑兵团。联邦军阿肯色军团骑兵师由约翰·戴维森准将指挥，他派第7密苏里志愿骑兵团担任先头部队，清除守在阿肯色河渡口附近的第5阿肯色骑兵团。该团当时由约翰·布尔少校临时指挥，罗伯特·C·牛顿上校则临时指挥旅部。

en.s: The Second Battle of Fort Sumter was fought on September 8, 1863, in Charleston Harbor. Confederate General P. G. T. Beauregard, who had commanded the defenses of Charleston and captured Fort Sumter in the first battle of the war, was in overall command of the defenders. In the battle, Union forces under Major General Quincy Gillmore attempted to retake the fort at the mouth of the harbor.

en.s: Genoa Cricket and Football Club (Italian pronunciation: [ˈdʒɛːnoa]) is an Italian professional football club based in Genoa, Liguria. The team competes in Serie A, the top division of the Italian football league system. Established in 1893, Genoa is Italy's oldest existing football team. The club has won the Italian Championship nine times, with their first being Italy's inaugural national championship in 1898, and their most recent coming after the 1923–24 season.

en.t: Qing China and eleven powers sign the Boxer Protocol in Beijing
en.s: On September 7, 1901, Qing representatives and diplomats of eleven foreign powers signed the Boxer Protocol in Beijing after the Boxer Uprising. The settlement imposed an indemnity of 450 million Haikwan taels on China and permitted foreign guards at specified points on the route between Beijing and the sea. The protocol took effect the same day.
en.n: The Boxer Protocol was signed and entered into force on September 7, 1901; the uprising itself unfolded earlier.

zh.t: 清政府与十一国在北京签订《辛丑条约》
zh.s: 1901年9月7日，清政府代表与十一国外交代表在北京签订《辛丑条约》，处理义和团运动和列强军事干预后的局势。条约规定中国支付4.5亿两海关银赔款，并允许外国军队在北京通往海边的若干地点驻守。条约于签署当天生效。
zh.n: 《辛丑条约》于1901年9月7日签订并生效；义和团运动发生在此前。

en.s: The Convention of Lhasa, officially the Convention Between Great Britain and Thibet, was a treaty signed in 1904 between Tibet and Great Britain, in Lhasa, the capital of Tibet, then claimed by the Chinese as a protectorate of the Qing dynasty. It was signed following the British expedition to Tibet of 1903–1904, a military expedition led by Colonel Francis Younghusband, and was followed by the Anglo-Chinese Convention of 1906.

en.t: The Legion of Mary, the largest apostolic organization of lay people in the Catholic Church, is founded in Dublin, Ireland
en.s: The Legion of Mary (Latin: Legio Mariae, postnominal abbreviation L.O.M.) is an international association of members of the Catholic Church who serve on a voluntary basis. It was founded in Dublin, as a Marian movement by the layman and civil servant Frank Duff. en.t: International Criminal Police Commission is founded in Vienna
en.s: On September 7, 1923, delegates at an international police congress in Vienna agreed to create the International Criminal Police Commission. The new body aimed to help police forces in different countries share information and cooperate on criminal investigations. It later became known as Interpol.

en.s: The Autumn Harvest Uprising (simplified Chinese: 秋收起义; traditional Chinese: 秋收起義; pinyin: Qīushōu Qǐyì) was an insurrection that took place in Hunan and Jiangxi provinces, China, on September 7, 1927, led by Mao Zedong, who established a short-lived Hunan Soviet. Mao led a small army of peasants against the Kuomintang and the landlords of Hunan. The uprising was defeated by Kuomintang forces and Mao was forced to retreat to the Jinggang Mountains on the border between Hunan and Jiangxi provinces, where emerged an army of miners. This was the first armed uprising by the Communists, and it marked a significant change in their strategy.

zh.s: 秋收起义（汉语拼音：Qīushōu Qǐyì）于1927年9月7日在中国湖南、江西两省爆发，由毛泽东领导。他建立了一个短暂存在的湖南苏维埃，并率领一支农民小部队对抗国民党和湖南地主。起义被国民党军队镇压后，毛泽东被迫撤至湘赣边界的井冈山，矿工队伍也在那里集结。这是共产党发动的第一次武装起义，也标志着其战略发生重大转变。

en.t: Second World War: The Luftwaffe changed their strategy in the Battle of Britain and began bombing London and other cities and towns
en.s: The Blitz (English: 'lightning') was a bombing campaign by Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy against the United Kingdom during the Second World War. The name is a shortened form of Blitzkrieg, a term used in the popular press to describe a German style of surprise attack used during the war.

en.s: The Pro Football Hall of Fame is the hall of fame for professional American football with a Mission to "Honor the Heroes of the Game, Preserve its History, Promote its Values & Celebrate Excellence. en.s: The 1999 Athens earthquake occurred on September 7 at 14:56:51 local time near Mount Parnitha in Greece with a moment magnitude of 6.0 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent). en.s: The 2004 Recopa Sudamericana was the 12th Recopa Sudamericana, an annual football match between the winners of the previous season's Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana competitions. The match was contested by Boca Juniors, winners of the 2003 Copa Libertadores, and Cienciano, winners of the 2003 Copa Sudamericana, on December 10, 2004. Cienciano managed to defeat Boca Juniors 2–4 on penalties after a 1–1 tie to win their first Recopa and obtain their second international title.

en.s: Presidential elections were held by the authoritarian Hosni Mubarak regime in Egypt on September 7, 2005, the first to feature more than one candidate. Incumbent president Hosni Mubarak was re-elected for a fifth consecutive six-year term in office, with official results showing he won 88.6% of the vote. The elections were marred by widespread reports of voter intimidation, payments to Mubarak voters, and pressure on poll workers to instruct voters to vote for Mubarak.

en.s: Unforgiven (2008) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE), which took place on September 7, 2008, at the Quicken Loans Arena in Cleveland, Ohio. It was the eleventh and final annual Unforgiven event, starring wrestlers from the Raw, SmackDown, and ECW brands. Seven professional wrestling matches were scheduled on the event's card, which featured a supercard, a scheduling of more than one main event. en.s: A federal election to determine the members of the 44th Parliament of Australia took place on 7 September 2013. The centre-right Liberal/National Coalition opposition led by then-Opposition leader Tony Abbott of the Liberal Party of Australia and Coalition partner the National Party of Australia, led by Warren Truss, defeated the incumbent centre-left Labor Party government of Prime Minister Kevin Rudd by a 17-seat 3.6 percentage point two-party swing. en.t: The National Unity Government of Myanmar declares a people's defensive war against the military junta during the Myanmar civil war
en.s: The National Unity Government of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar (Burmese: အမျိုးသားညီညွတ်ရေး အစိုးရ; abbreviated NUG) is an internationally unrecognized government-in-exile of Myanmar formed by the Committee Representing Pyidaungsu Hluttaw (CRPH), a group of elected lawmakers and members of parliament ousted in the 2021 Myanmar coup d'état. It includes representatives of the National League for Democracy (the deposed ruling party of former state counsellor Aung San Suu Kyi), ethnic minority insurgent groups, and various minor parties.
